en-IN.summary: Autonomous AI operating and decision layer for Indian SMBs and micro-enterprises.
en-IN.description: Vendo empowers business owners across retail, services, catering, manufacturing, and distribution to run their operations seamlessly via voice. Manage daily briefings, supplier quotes, inventory risks, approvals, and profitability without complex dashboards.

Alexa, which approvals need my attention?
